# Property: Style

The `.style` property lets JavaScript change the CSS of a selected element. Use it to update colors, sizes, backgrounds, and other styles while the page is running.
name: Property: Style
tips:
- Use `.style` on an element that has already been selected.
- Put the CSS value in quotation marks, like `"orange"` or `"24px"`.
- CSS property names with hyphens use camel case in JavaScript, like `backgroundColor` instead of `background-color`.
- Common style properties include `.color`, `.fontSize`, `.background`, and `.backgroundColor`.
- In Web Lab, `.style` often appears inside event handlers to change how an element looks after a click or input change.
